notes.title: 1.01 - Update #1
notes.notes:
-Increased speed boost time to 10 seconds
-Fixed music volume so it is on by default
-Added slider to adjust turn speed in space mode

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
The final release date for "The Giant Crab in Space" will be Aug 15, 2025. The game is complete at this time however I would like to allow of some time to do proper testing & quality control. If time allows I will also try to add a few cool new enemies and features. For example I have added a rudimentary random map generator which could be extended.
